step1_analysis.description: A high-speed CML 2:1 multiplexer used in the transmitter's 16:1 multiplexer tree. It steers a tail current to one of two differential output branches based on the select signal (SEL/SELN), effectively choosing between data inputs A/AN and B/BN.

power.description: DC power consumption of the multiplexer stage

sky130_expected.calculation: With VBIAS=1.2V, the tail current source (W=5u, L=0.5u) provides approx 0.8mA. Power = 1.8V * 0.8mA = 1.44mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS square-law approximation for the tail current source.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current ~0.8mA steered through a 500 ohm load resistor. Swing = 0.8mA * 500 ohm = 0.4V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CML swing is typically 300-500mV to keep transistors in saturation and maximize switching speed.

delay_A.description: Propagation delay from data input A to output

sky130_expected.calculation: RC delay dominated by load resistor (500 ohm) and parasitic/load capacitance (~50fF). Delay ~ 0.69 * RC = 17ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated based on the RC time constant of the output node. Must be well under 100ps for 10-Gb/s operation.

delay_SEL.description: Propagation delay from select input SEL to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to data delay, but includes the switching of the lower differential pair. Slightly longer than data delay.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The select signal has to switch the tail current between the two upper pairs, adding a small extra delay.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power, output swing, and propagation delays from both data and select inputs.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML 2:1 MUX Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 AN N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 B N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 SELN N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 BN N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 A N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 SEL N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Load resistors (required for CML operation)
R1 VDD N1 500
R2 VDD N2 500

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 1.2

* Input Stimuli (Common mode 1.55V, Swing 0.5V)
VA A 0 PWL(0 1.3 1n 1.3 1.05n 1.8 2n 1.8 2.05n 1.3 4n 1.3)
VAN AN 0 PWL(0 1.8 1n 1.8 1.05n 1.3 2n 1.3 2.05n 1.8 4n 1.8)
VB B 0 DC 1.8
VBN BN 0 DC 1.3
VSEL SEL 0 PWL(0 1.8 2.5n 1.8 2.55n 1.3 4n 1.3)
VSELN SELN 0 PWL(0 1.3 2.5n 1.3 2.55n 1.8 4n 1.8)

* Load capacitance
C1 N1 0 10f
C2 N2 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 4n

* Measure Output Swing
meas tran vhigh max v(n2)
meas tran vlow min v(n2)
let vswing = vhigh - vlow
print vswing

* Measure Propagation Delays
meas tran delay_A trig v(A) val=1.55 rise=1 targ v(n2) val=1.55 fall=1 td=0.9n
meas tran delay_SEL trig v(SEL) val=1.55 fall=1 targ v(n2) val=1.55 fall=1 td=2.4n

* Measure Rise and Fall Times (20% to 80% of 400mV swing)
meas tran trise_n2 trig v(n2) val=1.4 rise=1 targ v(n2) val=1.7 rise=1 td=1.9n
meas tran tfall_n2 trig v(n2) val=1.7 fall=1 targ v(n2) val=1.4 fall=1 td=0.9n

* Measure Power Consumption
meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD)
let power = -pwr_avg * 1.8
print power

quit
.endc
.end
